locale.description: BCP-47 locale selecting the built-in UI-text language (see config.labels). Empty = browser/session default.

orientation.description: Flow direction: 'horizontal' lays the tree left-to-right (depth along x); 'vertical' lays it top-to-bottom (depth along y).

showArrows.description: Draw an arrowhead at the target end of each connector to make flow direction explicit (useful for loops).

minXOffset.description: Minimum pixel spacing between depth columns; the grid stretches to fill the available width above this, and scrolls horizontally below it.

curveSize.description: Corner radius of connector bends, px.

nodeSize.description: Diameter of the node disc, px.

labels.description: Per-key overrides for built-in UI text. Unset keys follow config.locale.

noNodes.description: Empty-state text when data.nodes is empty.

noRoot.description: Empty-state hint when no root node can be found.

cyclic.description: Empty-state hint for the specific no-root case of a cycle (every node referenced).

backgroundColor.description: Node pill / info-card background colour — the halo behind labels where they cross connectors. Empty = the theme's --brn-node-bg.

data.description: The tree to draw. The ROOT is inferred: the node with outgoing edges that no other node references (output.hasRoot reports whether one exists).

edgeLabels.description: Optional per-edge overrides — label and/or styling (colour, line style, width), e.g. a dashed red fallback branch or a Yes/No decision label. Each item targets an existing edge by its endpoint ids; edges without an entry use the defaults (source-node colour, config.lineWidth, solid).

from.description: Source node id of the edge.

to.description: Target node id of the edge.

color.description: Connector colour (any CSS colour). Empty = inherit the source node's colour.

width.description: Stroke width, px. 0 or unset = use config.lineWidth.

nodes.description: Flat node array. Items stay open — extra fields ride along untouched.

category.description: Row bucket: lower categories render higher. Rows are the RANKS of the distinct categories, not their raw values.

nextId.description: Outgoing edges (ids). Dangling ids are ignored.

color.description: Node + outgoing connector colour (any CSS colour). Empty = theme line colour.

fill.description: Fill the disc with the colour (default true); false = outline only.

style.description: Style passthrough for the node wrapper.

tooltipStyle.description: Style passthrough for the info card.

selectedNode.description: Id of the selected (highlighted) node, -1 = none. Clicking writes it; writing it drives the highlight.

output.description: Read-only derived values (the component writes them; do not bind INTO them).

hasRoot.description: Whether a root could be inferred (false = nothing renders; check for cycles or missing edges).

warnings.description: Author-facing diagnostics for data that won't fully draw: no edges, a cycle (no entry point), edges to unknown ids, or nodes unreachable from the root (silently dropped). Empty = clean.
